topic: What your old iPhone is actually worth on Apple's India Exchange Offer, and why the number on the page is a ceiling not a quote
details: India page: iPhone 16 Pro Max up to Rs57000, 16 Pro Rs51500, 16 Plus Rs36000, 16 Rs36000. Headline: 'Buy a new iPhone today and get Rs4500.00-Rs57000.00 credit when you exchange.' Branded 'iPhone Exchange Offer'. Button is 'Get started', not 'Find your trade-in value'. Credit is tied to buying a new iPhone. Separate Android line Rs3000-Rs37000.
